name: jiachen
description: MCode Review, PR review that has to prove its findings: the same rules in your agent and in GitHub or GitLab CI, a verdict decided by a script, threads that carry over between pushes, and a weekly loop that tunes the rules on your own history. Plus finding the loops where you keep acting as a manual step for your agents, and a content pipeline that turns material into Xiaohongshu image posts and short vertical videos.
